title: people-ops recruiting coordinator daily scratchpad 2026-03-08
content:
Daily scratchpad - quick log + to-dos
Date: 2026-03-08
Owner: Casey Nguyen
Team: People Ops - Recruiting coordinator

Top priorities (today)
- [ ] Finalize panels for Backend Engineer (S-1) interviews at 10am PST on 3/10 (confirm Priya + two ICs)
- [ ] Follow up with candidates who were texted yesterday (see list below)
- [ ] Close scheduling loop for candidate feedback for 3 offers by EOD Thu
- [ ] Update interview blocks in team calendar (remove 11:30 slot; replace with 2pm buffer)
- [ ] Prep travel/reimbursements for onsite candidate (Emma R.) arriving 3/15

Morning callouts / quick notes
- 9:15am: Quick sync w/ Jordan - hiring manager Priya wants an earlier start for panel on Tue if possible. She can do 9:30am, but panelists Devon & Mariana prefer 10:00. Tentatively keep 10 and confirm before EOD.
- Candidate phone screen backlog trimmed to 4; target clearing 2 today.

Candidate follow-ups (actionable)
1) Emma Rodriguez - Backend Engineer (S-2)
   - Interview loop scheduled 2026-03-15 onsite. Candidate asked about travel stipend.
   - Action: send travel policy + reimbursement form (template below). Email sent? NO.
   - Next step: send email + cc Priya by 12pm today.

2) Marcus Lee - Data Engineer (S-1)
   - Completed take-home; waiting on hiring manager score.
   - Action: nudge Priya for score and recommended next step (onsite vs. another tech screen). Slack ping at ~10:30.

3) Priya Kaur - Product Designer (contract-to-hire)
   - 1:1 with hiring mgr done; candidate asked for comp range clarification.
   - Action: confirm comp range with Devon & send clarifying email to candidate by EOD. Use comp-template-04.

4) Daniel Park - Frontend Engineer (S-1)
   - Candidate needs reschedule; original slot 2026-03-09 11:30am PST. Candidate available 2026-03-11 2-4pm PST.
   - Action: offer 3/11 2:30pm (panel availability check). Update calendar if confirmed.

5) Noor Al-Hassan - Customer Success Manager
   - Had good convo with recruiter; wants faster timeline. Loop: hiring manager to decide final interview date.
   - Action: set expectation email - "aiming for decision within 2 weeks"; send today.

Templates/snippets (quick paste)
- Travel stipend email (short):
  Hi Emma,

  Thanks again for scheduling the onsite loop 3/15. Redwood covers roundtrip coach travel + one night of hotel for onsite interviews. Please fill out the attached reimbursement form and share receipts within 30 days. If you want, we can pre-book travel - let me know preferred travel times.

  Best,
  Casey

- Reschedule reply (short):
  Hi Daniel,

  Thanks for the heads up - 3/11 at 2:30pm PST works on our end pending panel confirmation. I’ll confirm final attendees in a follow-up.

  Cheers,
  Casey

Admin / Calendar housekeeping
- Remove recurring "interview buffer" 11:30-12:00 on Tuesdays next week (Devon asked).
- Add 30m prep block for Priya before backend panel on 3/10.
- Check resource calendar to ensure conference room B is free for onsite 3/15 (Emma).

Notes to self (quick, messy)
- Remember to attach reimbursement pdf (reimb-form-v2.pdf) when emailing Emma. File in drive under people-ops/resources.
- Update "candidate take-home" folder with Marcus's submission (link from GH).
- Double-check comp bands doc before sending Priya the range - last update 2026-02-20.

Follow-ups to log (after actions completed)
- [ ] Email Emma w/ travel form sent - track response
- [ ] Ping Priya for Marcus's score - add to JIRA HIR-4321 comment
- [ ] Confirm Daniel reschedule & update calendar event id
- [ ] Send comp clarification to Priya Kaur

Questions / blockers
- Hiring mgr Priya is out Thurs afternoon - might delay decisions; flag to Jordan if any candidate needs immediate move.
- Need final panel list for Backend S-1 (two ICs + Priya). Who's the second IC? (likely Devon, confirm)

End-of-day quick log (fill in later)
- 5:45pm: actions completed: __________
- Outstanding: __________

Scratchpad / quick links (for copy/paste)
- Slack: #recruiting-ops (pin notes)
- Confluence: Interview Guide - /display/PE/Interview+Guide
- JIRA: HIR-4321 (Backend S-1 loop)
- Templates folder: people-ops/templates/email-templates v4

Random notes to self (shortcuts)
- If a candidate asks for remote-only: check "remote-eligibility" tag in ATS (manual)
- Keep buffer day Fridays light for offer admin

---
End scratchpad. Will copy to candidate tracker once items start closing.
